summary: 5 film announcements, 7 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Stag Dance
film.announcement: Run-A-Muck is developing Torrey Peters' novella 'Stag Dance' (part of 2026 Pulitzer Prize finalist collection) into a film.

film.title: Nice Eggs
film.announcement: Coming-of-age drama 'Nice Eggs' stars Jane Krakowski and Angourie Rice, directed by Amanda Lipitz.

film.title: Touch Grass
film.talent: Dave Clark (director), Brad Miska, Chris White (producers)
film.announcement: Promise AI is developing horror feature 'Touch Grass' with Dave Clark directing and Brad Miska and 'Backrooms' EP Chris White producing.

film.title: Ink
film.announcement: Netflix sets U.S. release date for Danny Boyle's tabloid drama 'Ink' starring Guy Pearce as Rupert Murdoch for December theatrical release.

film.title: Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint
film.announcement: Samuel Goldwyn acquires North America rights to WestEnd Films' holiday comedy 'Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint'.

tv.title: Monsterverse Series
tv.talent: Wyatt Russell, Connie Nielsen, Stana Katic
tv.announcement: Connie Nielsen and Stana Katic join the Wyatt Russell-led Monsterverse series for Apple TV.

tv.title: Ascension
tv.announcement: Apple TV orders Alfonso Cuarón's cult horror thriller series 'Ascension' starring Caitríona Balfe.

tv.title: Dig
tv.announcement: Peacock sets premiere date for comedy series 'Dig' starring Amy Poehler and Hugh Laurie from Mike Schur and J.J. Philbin.

tv.title: The Sticks
tv.talent: Michelle Monaghan, Scott Bakula, Logan Marshall-Green
tv.announcement: Netflix YA hockey drama 'The Sticks' stars Michelle Monaghan with Scott Bakula and Logan Marshall-Green confirmed in cast.

tv.title: Clueless Series
tv.announcement: 'Clueless' series is among recipients of latest California TV tax credit allocations.

tv.title: Ascent
tv.announcement: Viola Davis' 'Ascent' is among recipients of latest California TV tax credit allocations.

tv.title: Ted Lasso Season 4
tv.announcement: Tanya Reynolds joins 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 as a tough and cold women's soccer coach.
